name: workspaces: any column updatable
find: grant update (name, sort_order, edited_at, deleted_at) on workspaces to ledger_app;
replace: grant update on workspaces to ledger_app;

name: projects: any column updatable
find: grant update (name, color, sort_order, edited_at, deleted_at) on projects to ledger_app;
replace: grant update on projects to ledger_app;

name: items: any column updatable
find:
grant update (type, project_id, title, status, priority, due_date, start_date, recurring, remind_days_before,
  remind_off, notes, sort_order, subtasks, details, edited_at, deleted_at) on items to ledger_app;
replace: grant update on items to ledger_app;

name: change log editable
find:
create trigger change_log_append_only before update or delete on change_log
  for each row execute function app.refuse_change_log_edits();

name: change log truncatable
find:
create trigger change_log_no_truncate before truncate on change_log
  for each statement execute function app.refuse_change_log_edits();
